# The Hadwiger-Nelson Problem

The Hadwiger-Nelson problem asks for the minimum number of colors required to
color the plane such that no two points at unit distance from each other have
the same color.

*Reference:* [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hadwiger%E2%80%93Nelson_problem)

This file points to the canonical formalization in `FormalConjectures.ErdosProblems.«508»`.
-/

review.notes: The reviewed file is an import-only pointer to Erdős problem 508. It introduces no declarations, answer markers, or status/formal_proof annotations. Its description and canonical import agree with the cited Wikipedia source, which explicitly formulates the problem as finding the chromatic number of the plane’s unit-distance graph and still records the answer as unknown among 5, 6, and 7. Supplemental Lean checks in /workspace/review/scratch.lean compiled successfully: they establish the correspondence with proper colorings of the Euclidean plane, prove the minimum-color characterization, and check empty-vertex and zero-color cases. Direct access to erdosproblems.com/508 was blocked by Cloudflare despite descriptive User-Agent headers; the target’s cited Wikipedia source was accessible and sufficient for this review.
